What is known about multiplayer, and what is honestly untested.

Multiplayer

Nothing about multiplayer is promised.

What there is not

No shared colony
No shared map
No synchronised research

What it would be

Each player runs their own company, in their own colony, on their own map.

Not one base with several people in it.

What has been tested

Nothing. No multiplayer session has been run.

If you try it anyway

It is not blocked. But treat it as untested: back up your save, and expect the single-player experience to be the supported one.

Report what happens — see Links.
